title: 第一卷 第21章 看看谁杀谁第一卷 第22章 收钱
content_zh:
“那李乘风怎么看着壮了这么多？”
刘勇心中发狠的同时，想到刚才所见的李乘风身上气势，眉宇间又涌现一抹困惑。
那李乘风还是他安排的刘宏敲闷棍，一棍下来，在床上躺了两三天才好，前几天见着还畏畏缩缩的样子，怎么今天再见变得如此气盛？
“看来是吃好了肉，在山里跑路把身子练出来了。”
刘勇想到自己刚才居然被他强壮的身板给压迫住，居然一时没有敢翻脸，心中羞怒，脸色难堪地踏步走到了郑老爷家里。
“哼，喜欢在山林里狩猎打肉是吧？我倒要看看死到临头的时候，你还有没有这个气势……”
“………………”
走在回家的路上，李乘风想到刚才和刘勇对话的一幕，脸上忍不住露出一抹笑容。
他握了握自己结实有力的拳头，低头看着胳膊上结实的肌肉，感受着对比刚刚穿越来强壮了许多的身体，心中轻笑。
“幸好把身体练起来了，否则的话，那刘勇绝对不会这么轻易的就把话松开。”
李乘风心中暗想，脸上的笑容越发地满意起来，“如此一来，刘勇再想找事，最少也是等我把猪肉吃完进山林以后的事了。”
他想到刘勇最后警告他时的狠辣神色，眼里闪过一抹精光。
“想杀我？哼！看看倒地是谁杀谁！”
李乘风心中冷笑，他现在太极拳刚刚提升一个层次，就拥有整劲这般神奇的力量，能让那刘勇忌惮。
等到之后将太极拳提升到更高层次，练出更强的身体，再加上这些天他在家就打算突破到大乘的箭术。
到时候在山林之中，谁杀谁也犹未可知呢！
“罢了，既然如此，就先在家里把箭术练到大成。”
李乘风心中念头闪烁，收定心思，大步往家中赶去。
不多时，他回到家里，敲了敲院门，刘玉娘急忙过来给他开门。
“乘风，没什么事吧？”

刘玉娘看着李乘风出门办事又这么快回来，关切地问道。
“没事，放宽心。”
李乘风脸上露出笑容地开口，说话之际，对她挑了挑眉毛，“就是要劳烦玉娘给我用稻草编一个靶子，我想练练箭法。”
“稻草靶子，好！”
刘玉娘听到李乘风要她帮忙，立即高兴地开口，但说完又想了想，忍不住地看着他问，“靶子编成啥样的呀？”
“就跟屁股垫差不多，圆的有巴掌厚就行，不用太大，能有洗脸盆那么大就行。”
李乘风这才想起来，刘玉娘身为朴实的底层百姓是没见过这些东西的，立即笑着开口。
“哎，好，我这就给你去编。”
刘玉娘一听，心里就有谱了，说着话就迈开脚，跑到柴火垛里薅着稻草，开始飞快地编织了起来。
李乘风看着刘玉娘的动作，脸上露出了一抹微笑。
有一个通情达理的女人在家里，确实好。
心中念想，刘玉娘编织箭靶的功夫他也没有闲着，而是将那把层压竹弓和以前的竹箭找出来，规整了一下，确保能用之后，才满意地放在一边。
content_en:
"Then why does Li Chengfeng look so much stronger?"
While Liu Yong was furious, he thought of the aura of Li Chengfeng he had just seen, and a trace of confusion emerged between his brows.
Li Chengfeng was still the one he arranged for Liu Hong to beat the sap, and he lay on the bed for two or three days before he felt better. He was still timid when he saw him a few days ago, so why did he become so energetic when he saw her again today?
"It seems like you've got some good physical fitness from eating meat and running around in the mountains."
Liu Yong thought that he had been oppressed by his strong body just now, but he didn't dare to turn his face for a moment. He felt ashamed and angry, and walked to Master Zheng's house with an embarrassed face.
"Hmph, you like hunting in the mountains and forests, don't you? I want to see if you still have this momentum when death is imminent..."
"………………"
On the way home, Li Chengfeng thought of the conversation he had just had with Liu Yong, and couldn't help but smile.
He clenched his strong fists, looked down at the strong muscles on his arms, and chuckled in his heart as he felt that his body was much stronger than when he had just traveled through time.
"Fortunately, I have trained my body. Otherwise, Liu Yong would never let go of his words so easily."
Li Chengfeng thought to himself, and the smile on his face became more and more satisfied, "In this case, if Liu Yong wants to cause trouble, at least it will be after I finish eating the pork and go into the forest."
He thought of Liu Yong's cruel look when he warned him at the end, and a glint flashed in his eyes.
"Want to kill me? Humph! Look who falls to the ground and kill whom!"
Li Chengfeng sneered in his heart. He had just advanced his Tai Chi to a new level and already had the magical power of Zheng Jin, which could make Liu Yong fearful.
Later, he will upgrade Tai Chi to a higher level and develop a stronger body. In addition, he plans to break through to Mahayana archery at home these days.
At that time, in the mountains and forests, it is still unclear who will kill whom!
"Well, in that case, let's practice archery at home first."
Li Chengfeng had thoughts flashing in his mind, collected his thoughts, and strode home.
Not long after, he returned home and knocked on the courtyard door. Liu Yuniang hurriedly came over and opened the door for him.
"Chengfeng, is everything okay?"
Liu Yuniang asked with concern as she watched Li Chengfeng go out to do errands and come back so quickly.
"It's okay, relax."
Li Chengfeng spoke with a smile on his face. As he spoke, he raised his eyebrows at her, "I just want to trouble Lady Yu to weave a target out of straw for me. I want to practice my archery skills."
"Straw target, okay!"
When Liu Yuniang heard that Li Chengfeng asked her for help, she immediately spoke happily, but after thinking about it, she couldn't help looking at him and asked, "What kind of target is it?"
"It's just like a butt pad. It just needs to be round and as thick as a palm. It doesn't have to be too big. It just needs to be as big as a washbasin."
Li Chengfeng then remembered that Liu Yuniang, as a simple lower-class citizen, had never seen these things, and immediately smiled and spoke.
"Hey, okay, I'll make it up for you right now."
When Liu Yuniang heard this, she knew something in her heart. As she spoke, she stepped forward, ran to the firewood pile, gathered straw, and began to weave quickly.
Li Chengfeng looked at Liu Yuniang's movements with a smile on his face.
It is indeed good to have a reasonable woman at home.
Thinking in his mind, he did not idle away while Liu Yuniang was weaving the archery target. Instead, he found the laminated bamboo bow and the old bamboo arrows, arranged them to make sure they were usable, and then put them aside with satisfaction.
